title: QR Switch Portal
summary: Fintech portal built from scratch with real-time transaction monitoring, encryption, authentication, and dynamic permissions.
description: A secure fintech portal delivering real-time transaction visibility and role-based access control. Built end-to-end with a focus on performance, security, and operational reliability.
challenges: Delivering live transaction updates without compromising security.
Modeling dynamic permissions across operational roles.
lessons: Early permission modeling reduces late-stage UI rework.
Real-time UX needs clear loading and reconnect states.

title: ATM VAS Portal
summary: Modular ATM value-added services portal with user management, roles, permissions, and reusable components.
description: Enterprise portal for ATM value-added services with a modular architecture, strong access control, and a reusable component layer for faster feature delivery.
challenges: Keeping UI consistency while shipping quickly.
lessons: Shared components pay off fastest in admin-heavy products.

title: Shared UI Library
summary: Enterprise Angular component library with standalone components, shared across multiple products.
description: A design-system-oriented Angular UI library that standardizes patterns, reduces duplication, and accelerates delivery across enterprise applications.
challenges: Documenting APIs so teams adopt components confidently.
lessons: Good docs are as important as good components.
Constraints in the API improve consistency.

title: Modeer360 CRM
summary: Enterprise CRM platform modules for contacts, inventory, deals, campaigns, chat, and calls.
description: Contributed to Modeer360 by building reusable dashboards, tables, filtering systems, data visualization, and real-time communication with SignalR.
challenges: Unifying messaging channels into one chat experience.
Building extensible tables and filters for diverse CRM data.
architecture: Reusable data table and filter frameworks
Dynamic forms replacing legacy form solutions
lessons: Extensible table/filter abstractions unlock many features.
Cross-functional collaboration is critical for enterprise CRM delivery.
